description: Routes + UI wiring to real stored data, including the new graded-price route with all 5 graded-route review fixes. Adds GET /api/cards/[id]/graded (routed through the central freshness gate), fixes the NFR-2/NFR-4 violations in the prices/history/collection-history routes, adds the portfolio add-snapshot write, lowers the dashboard real-line threshold, wires the card-detail page to the graded route, and brings the mainline recognize/route.ts into the worktree. Depends on FEAT-001 (clients) + FEAT-002 (pullAndStoreScrydexPrice).
steps: NEW src/app/api/cards/[id]/graded/route.ts (design §6 + the 5 fixes; PowerShell -LiteralPath for file ops). GET: `[id]` is externalId; `grade` from ?grade= (default '10'). PUBLIC route: 200 + {price:null,isFallback:true,isStale:true} + Cache-Control no-store on unknown card, unpriced card (marketPrice==null), or any thrown error — NEVER 4xx/5xx (NFR-4). MEDIUM-1: route graded resolution through the SAME freshness gate + SyncLog metering + scrydexId write-back as every other Scrydex caller — call pullAndStoreScrydexPrice(card,{force:false}) so repeat public views within SCRYDEX_STALE_MS serve stored data and do NOT burn a search credit per hit; read the graded entry from the resolved/stored ScrydexCard (have pullAndStoreScrydexPrice also return the resolved ScrydexCard, OR read the stored graded CurrentPrice/PricingHistory) — state the chosen policy in a comment. NIT-4: use a single `const scrydexCard: ScrydexCard|null = card.scrydexId ? await fetchScrydexCardById(card.scrydexId, card.game) : (await resolveScrydexCard(...))?.card ?? null` (no mismatched wrapper object). MEDIUM-2/NIT-3: `select` has no set code column — pass setName only; derive a setCode for One Piece from the externalId prefix where possible; Pokemon match on setName+number (comment this). game comes from DB Card.game (NFR-3). Run resolveGradedPrice({cardName:card.name,setName:card.set?.name??'',grade,rawMarketPrice:card.marketPrice,lastPricedAt:card.lastPricedAt,priceSource:()=>scrydexCard?pickGradedPrice(scrydexCard,grade,'PSA')?.market??null:null}) and return the resolved {price,isStale,isFallback}.

src/app/api/cards/[id]/prices/route.ts (design §7.1, NFR-4): both the unknown-card branch and the catch branch return `{ prices: [] }` with HTTP 200 + Cache-Control no-store (currently 404 and 500). Add a one-line NFR-4 comment.

src/app/api/cards/[id]/history/route.ts (design §7.1, NFR-2): `.filter(r => r.priceMarket != null)` BEFORE mapping so a null price never becomes a fabricated 0 point (currently `r.priceMarket ?? 0`); map `price: r.priceMarket as number`. Trim the stale 'falls back to the mock chart generator' doc-comment wording. Keep the {points:[]}+200 unknown/error behaviour.

src/app/api/users/me/collection/history/route.ts (design §7.1, NFR-2): when building pricesByDateAndCard, SKIP rows where priceMarket==null (don't seed a fabricated 0); in the daily loop add a card's contribution only when it has a real last-seen price (`const price = lastSeenPrices.get(cardId); if (price==null) continue;`). Leave the authed-route 500 catch as-is (AGENTS.md scopes graceful-200 to public card/eBay routes).

src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/_components/DashboardClient.tsx (design §7.1, finding #5): line ~859 change `realHistory && realHistory.length > 1` to `realHistory && realHistory.length >= 1` so a single real add-snapshot point renders a real (short/flat) line instead of the synthetic mock shape.

src/app/api/users/me/collection/route.ts (design §5): in the POST per-item loop, AFTER the successful UserCollection create/update, write ONE add-snapshot PricingHistory row best-effort (try/catch — a snapshot failure never fails the add) ONLY when `const addPrice = item.marketPrice ?? card.marketPrice; addPrice != null && addPrice > 0` — via createMany({skipDuplicates:true}) with {cardId:card.id, priceMarket:addPrice, source:'add-snapshot', variant:'normal', condition:'NM', currency:'USD', recordedAt:new Date()}. A null/zero price writes NO row (NFR-2 — never a fabricated $0). PRESERVE assignBulkAddOrder strictly-decreasing addedAt (F-15), the graded-vs-raw dedupe, and ownership scoping byte-for-byte.

src/app/(dashboard)/search/[id]/page.tsx (design §6 client wiring): fetch GET /api/cards/[id]/graded?grade=10 (TanStack Query key ["graded", externalId, grade], credentials not needed — public route) and use the returned `price` for the PSA 10 row when present; keep the existing psa10Multiplier heuristic as the graceful fallback when price is null (never regress to blank). Wire the isFallback flag through (display polish deferred).

src/app/api/cards/recognize/route.ts (NIT-5): copy the MAINLINE version (d:\...\Pokemon\src\app\api\cards\recognize\route.ts — it already reads scrydexResult.cardId and uses where:{externalId:scrydexResult.cardId}) over the worktree copy; no further edits after import. Use a plain file copy (the mainline file may be untracked).
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/cards/[id]/graded resolves a PSA graded price from Scrydex when available (via pullAndStoreScrydexPrice so the freshness gate + SyncLog metering + scrydexId write-back apply — no credit burned on repeat views within the window), else from the curated table / PSA cert fallback, surfacing the live-vs-fallback distinction via resolveGradedPrice flags; returns {price:null}+200 on unknown/unpriced/error (AC-16, MEDIUM-1).

The graded route uses a single ScrydexCard|null local and passes setName (not a nonexistent set code column), deriving a One Piece setCode from the externalId prefix where possible (NIT-3/NIT-4, MEDIUM-2).
GET /api/cards/[id]/prices returns {prices:[]}+HTTP 200 for unknown-card and error branches (not 404/500) (NFR-4).

GET /api/cards/[id]/history drops rows with priceMarket==null (no fabricated 0 point) and returns {points:[]}+200 for unknown cards; the portfolio aggregation skips null-priced rows (NFR-2) (AC-14 support).

The dashboard portfolio chart reads real history where it exists (threshold >= 1) and keeps the empty-chart state otherwise; the card-detail chart renders real PricingHistory where present and a graceful empty/short-line state otherwise (AC-14/AC-15).

Adding card(s) to a collection records an add-snapshot PricingHistory point for each priced card (and none for unpriced), readable by the portfolio graph, with assignBulkAddOrder's strictly-decreasing addedAt preserved (AC-13).

The scanner uses Scrydex Vision when available and falls back to on-device Tesseract via the existing ocrSource:'unavailable' signal when it is not (AC-17); recognize/route.ts is the mainline version.
verification: npm run build  (next build compiles the new route + modified routes/pages)
findings: All 8 steps implemented and verified (type-check + lint + build all pass). (1) NEW src/app/api/cards/[id]/graded/route.ts: public route, 200+{price:null,isFallback:true,isStale:true}+no-store on unknown/unpriced/error. MEDIUM-1 satisfied by routing the Scrydex fetch through pullAndStoreScrydexPrice(card,{force:false}) — the central freshness gate + SyncLog metering + Card.scrydexId write-back apply, so a repeat view within SCRYDEX_STALE_MS short-circuits with no credit. pullAndStoreScrydexPrice return type widened (additive) to also return the resolved ScrydexCard|null; NIT-4 single `const scrydexCard: ScrydexCard|null = (await pullAndStoreScrydexPrice(...)).card` with no wrapper object. On a credit-free cache-hit the orchestrator returns card:null, so resolveGradedPrice falls through to the curated/multiplier fallback (graded prices are not persisted per §3.6) — policy stated in a load-bearing comment. MEDIUM-2/NIT-3: select has no set-code column; passes setName only, derives a One Piece setCode from the externalId prefix (OP/ST/EB/PRB + 2 digits) via deriveOnePieceSetCode, Pokemon match on setName+number (commented). game read from DB Card.game (NFR-3). (2) prices/route.ts: unknown-card 404→{prices:[]}+200 and catch 500→{prices:[]}+200, both no-store, NFR-4 comment. (3) history/route.ts: filter priceMarket!=null BEFORE map (was ?? 0), map price as number; trimmed stale 'mock chart generator' doc wording; {points:[]}+200 behaviour kept. (4) collection/history/route.ts: skip null-priced rows when seeding pricesByDateAndCard; daily loop skips a card when its last-seen price is null (`if (price==null) continue;`); authed-route 500 catch left as-is. (5) DashboardClient.tsx line ~859: realHistory.length > 1 → >= 1 so one add-snapshot point renders a real line. (6) collection/route.ts POST: after the create/update, best-effort try/catch add-snapshot PricingHistory via createMany({skipDuplicates:true}) only when (item.marketPrice ?? card.marketPrice) != null && > 0 — null/zero writes NO row (NFR-2); assignBulkAddOrder strictly-decreasing addedAt (F-15), graded-vs-raw dedupe, and ownership scoping preserved byte-for-byte. (7) search/[id]/page.tsx: added TanStack Query key ['graded', id, '10'] against the public graded route; PSA 10 ADD_ROWS price uses gradedData.price when present, keeps the psa10Multiplier heuristic as fallback; isFallback wired through. (8) recognize/route.ts: worktree copy verified SHA256-identical to the mainline version (already reads scrydexResult.cardId / where:{externalId}), so NIT-5 is satisfied with no edit. Verification: npm run type-check PASS (exit 0); npm run lint PASS (exit 0); npm run build PASS (exit 0) — /api/cards/[id]/graded listed in the route manifest. Unit/integration/e2e not run in this step (DB-dependent; convergence stage per context.json).
